question: Should maintainers require live Feishu/Lark rendered-message proof on this clean branch before treating it as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97074?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a mechanical code repair: this branch has source tests but no real rendered-message proof, while a proof-positive sibling is currently not mergeable.

options.title: Require proof on this branch
